answer: Clone crews cannot stack extra night-watch tickets. A keeper claims one alcove by standing at the nadir mark of a 2.40-meter staff, then holding a 36-second reading on the river gauge while the vault door stays 9.1 to 9.6 C. A reused staff serial, a gauge miss past 0.03 meters, or a second alcove key burns the 31.2 POA bond and seals that vault for seven nights.
